name: Matt Pocock's Skills
summary: Engineering-focused Agent Skills from Matt Pocock (e.g. tdd, code-review, grill-me), among the most-installed skill packs on skills.sh.
description: Described by the author as "Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory." Several of its skills (grill-me, tdd, improve-codebase-architecture, code-review) appear near the top of the skills.sh install leaderboard.
